name: Employee, 120,000, church tax 9%
workings: Contributions (employee shares, childless): pension 9.3% × 101,400 = 9,430.20; unemployment 1.3% = 1,318.20; health (7.3% + 1.45%) × 69,750 = 6,103.125; care 2.4% = 1,674.00

Special expenses: pension 9,430.20 (employee and employer shares within 30,826, less the employer's); health × 0.96 (sick pay) + care = 7,533.00, above 1,900, so the unemployment contribution isn't deductible
Church tax (9%) replaces the €36 lump sum and depends on the tax: K = 9% × T(101,806.80 − K); fixed point K = 2,742.426614, taxable income 99,064.373386
